latest.title: France: EIB and BPCE SA signed a EUR 900 million intermediated loan for renewable energy projects
latest.text: In February 2026, the European Investment Bank (EIB) and BPCE SA signed a EUR 900 million intermediated lending facility to support small to mid-sized renewable energy projects in France regarding onshore wind, photovoltaic, geothermal, biomass and biogas.

latest.title: France: Budget increase of tax relief scheme for data storage centres
latest.text: In January 2026, the French government announced an increase in the annual budget of the reduced electricity excise duty scheme for data storage centres.

latest.title: France: EUR 20 billion for reformed electricity capacity mechanism
latest.text: In December 2025, the European Commission approved a state aid scheme from France to support the reform of its electricity capacity mechanism to ensure security of electricity supply and advance the deployment of clean energy.

latest.title: France: EUR 167.8 million restructuring aid scheme to Corsair for long-term viability
latest.text: In December 2025, the European Commission approved a state aid measure from France to support Corsair.

latest.title: France: EIB and NATIXIS sign a EUR 250 million loan guarantee programme for the wind energy supply chain
latest.text: In December 2025, the European Investment Bank (EIB) and NATIXIS signed a EUR 250 million (USD 293.2 million) loan guarantee programme in France.

latest.title: France: EUR 2.5 billion subsidy scheme for large industrial decarbonisation projects
latest.text: In December 2025, the European Commission approved a state aid scheme from France to support large industrial decarbonisation projects.

latest.title: France: Government announces a EUR 749.3 million equity injection in satellite operator Eutelsat
latest.text: In December 2025, the government of France, through the Agence des participations de l'État (APE), participated in Eutelsat's capital increases, providing EUR 749.3 (USD 879.5) million.

latest.title: France: EUR 24.6 million financial grant for Safran Aircraft Engines under Horizon Europe
latest.text: In December 2025, the European Commission disclosed a financial grant to Safran Aircraft Engines for its participation in the "TAKE OFF" project.

latest.title: France: EUR 21.2 million financial grant for Airbus Operations SAS under Horizon Europe
latest.text: In December 2025, the European Commission awarded a financial grant to Airbus Operations SAS for its participation in the "TAKE OFF" project.

latest.title: Philippines: National policy framework for developing the critical minerals industry
latest.text: In August 2026, the President of the Philippines established a national policy framework for the critical minerals industry, directing the Board of Investments to promote investment in value-added critical mineral processing and downstream industries.

latest.title: Philippines: Introduction of clearance fee and licensing requirement on artificial sweetener imports
latest.text: In August 2026, the Philippine Sugar Regulatory Administration announced the introduction of a clearance fee and a licensing requirement for the importation of artificial sweeteners.

latest.title: Philippines: Export ban on fresh purple yam (ube) and its planting materials
latest.text: In September 2026, the Philippine Department of Agriculture disclosed the indefinite suspension of exports of fresh purple yam (ube) and its propagative planting materials, effective mid-August 2026.

latest.title: Philippines: Imposition of volume-based special safeguard duties on certain meat products (August 2026)
latest.text: In August 2026, the Philippines announced the imposition of volume-based special safeguard duties on imports of certain meat products.

latest.title: Philippines: LandBank provides a PHP 155 billion loan to Power Sector Assets and Liabilities Management Corporation
latest.text: In August 2026, the LandBank of the Philippines announced a term loan facility for the Power Sector Assets and Liabilities Management Corporation to sustain critical energy obligations.

latest.title: Philippines: Introduction of the Electric Vehicle Incentive Strategy (EVIS) Program
latest.text: In July 2026, the Government of the Philippines established the Electric Vehicle Incentive Strategy (EVIS) Program worth up to PHP 60 billion (USD 976.68 million) to promote the domestic manufacturing of electric vehicles through tax incentives.

latest.title: Philippines: Framework to investigate and prohibit the importation of goods produced through forced labour
latest.text: In July 2026, the Government of the Philippines established a framework to investigate and prohibit the importation of goods produced wholly or in part through forced labour.

latest.title: Philippines: Increased minimum NFA buying price for rice and temporary import restrictions at Iloilo ports
latest.text: In July 2026, the Department of Agriculture of the Philippines announced an increase in the minimum buying price for unmilled rice and a temporary halt to rice imports at ports in Iloilo.

latest.title: Philippines: LandBank provides project financing to Citicore Renewable Energy Corporation
latest.text: In July 2026, the LandBank of the Philippines announced a project finance loan facility for Citicore Renewable Energy Corporation to support the development of two solar power plants.

latest.title: Philippines: LandBank provides financing to Archipelago Renewables Corporation
latest.text: In June 2026, the LandBank of the Philippines announced a financing agreement with Archipelago Renewables Corporation to fund renewable energy microgrids in Palawan.

latest.title: Philippines: Import ban on feedstocks used in the manufacture of bioethanol
latest.text: In June 2026, the Philippine government announced an import ban on feedstocks used in the manufacture of bioethanol.

latest.title: Philippines: President approves 2026 Strategic Investment Priority Plan
latest.text: In June 2026, the Government of the Philippines approved the 2026 Strategic Investment Priority Plan, establishing the framework for granting fiscal incentives to projects in priority economic sectors.

latest.title: Philippines: Minimum access volume for pork imports increased for 2026
latest.text: In May 2026, the Government of the Philippines increased the minimum access volume for pork meat imports from 54'210 MT to 204'210 MT for the year 2026.

latest.title: Philippines: MIC provides PHP 15 billion credit facility to Petron Corporation
latest.text: In May 2026, the Maharlika Investment Corporation (MIC) announced a PHP 15 billion revolving credit facility for Petron Corporation to support the purchase and importation of crude oil and refined petroleum products.

latest.title: Philippines: Imposition of a temporary price cap on imported rice
latest.text: In May 2026, the Philippine Government imposed a PHP 50 per kilogram price ceiling on imported rice (5% broken) from 13 May to 11 June 2026.

latest.title: Philippines: Development Bank of the Philippines provides PHP 2 billion loan to PH1 World Landscapes Inc
latest.text: In April 2026, the state-owned Development Bank of the Philippines (DBP) announced a PHP 2 billion loan agreement with housing developer PH1 World Landscapes Inc to fund the construction of residential units.

latest.title: Philippines: Small Business Corporation and PCCI launch PHP 7 billion loan facility for MSMEs
latest.text: In April 2026, the Small Business Corporation of the Philippines launched a PHP 7 billion loan facility to provide financial assistance to micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises.

latest.title: Philippines: Imposition of price-based special safeguard duties on certain agricultural products (April 2026)
latest.text: In April 2026, the government of the Philippines announced the imposition of price-based special safeguard duties on imports of certain agricultural products.

latest.title: Philippines: Department of Agriculture provides PHP 10 billion cash assistance for farmers and fisherfolk
latest.text: In April 2026, the Department of Agriculture announced a PHP 10 billion cash assistance scheme to support farmers and fisherfolk nationwide. The programme aims to mitigate the impact of rising production and input costs.

latest.title: Philippines: President issues the Thirteenth Regular Foreign Investment Negative List
latest.text: In April 2026, the Philippines issued the Thirteenth Regular Foreign Investment Negative List. The list specifies sectors where foreign equity is prohibited or limited to certain percentages.

latest.title: Philippines: Transport subsidies and fuel discounts to support public utility vehicle operators
latest.text: In April 2026, the Philippine government announced the implementation of a nationwide transport assistance package, including service contracting payments and fuel subsidies for public utility vehicles, effective 15 April 2026.

latest.title: Philippines: Initiation of safeguard investigation on imports of rice
latest.text: In March 2026, the Philippine authorities initiated a safeguard investigation on imports of rice. The investigation is still in progress.

latest.title: Philippines: Civil Aviation Authority reduces aeronautical fees for airlines
latest.text: In March 2026, the Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines announced a reduction in aeronautical fees for airlines across airports nationwide, effective 1 April 2026.

latest.title: Philippines: Declaring a state of national energy emergency and authorising the Unified Package for Livelihoods, Industry, Food, and Transport (UPLIFT)
latest.text: In March 2026, the President of the Philippines declared a state of national energy emergency and authorised the implementation of the Unified Package for Livelihoods, Industry, Food, and Transport (UPLIFT) to address energy supply disruptions.

latest.title: Philippines: DTI launches PHP 3 billion loan facility for exporters
latest.text: In March 2026, the Department of Trade and Industry of the Philippines launched a PHP 3 billion loan facility to support exporters with production expansion and equipment upgrades.

latest.title: Philippines: Department of Agriculture introduces a 250'000 MT import quota for frozen fish and fishery products
latest.text: In March 2026, the Philippine Department of Agriculture approved the importation of 250'000 MT of frozen fish and aquatic products.

latest.title: Philippines: Initiation of safeguard investigation on imports of ceramic tiles
latest.text: In February 2026, the Philippine authorities initiated a preliminary safeguard investigation on imports of ceramic tiles. The investigation is still in progress.

latest.title: Philippines: Export quota of 100'000 MT of raw sugar to the United States for crop year 2025-2026
latest.text: In January 2026, the Sugar Regulatory Administration of the Philippines introduced an export quota of 100'000 MT of raw sugar to the United States for the crop year 2025-2026.

latest.title: Philippines: Department of Agriculture imposes a maximum suggested retail price on imported carrots
latest.text: In December 2025, the Department of Agriculture of the Philippines imposed a PHP 120 per kilogram maximum suggested retail price (MSRP) for imported carrots, applicable within public and private wet markets in the National Capital Region (NCR).

latest.title: Philippines: Department of Agriculture raises maximum suggested retail price for imported red onions
latest.text: In December 2025, the Department of Agriculture of the Philippines raised the maximum suggested retail price of imported red onions from PHP 120 (USD 2.02) to PHP 150 (USD 2.53) per kilogram.

latest.title: Philippines: Department of Agriculture imposes the maximum suggested retail price on imported red and white onions
latest.text: In December 2025, the Department of Agriculture of the Philippines imposed a PHP 120 per kilogram maximum suggested retail price (MSRP) on imported red and white onions. On 11 December 2025, the MSRP for red onions was increased to PHP 150 per kilogram, while the level of MSRP for white onions remained unchanged.

latest.title: Philippines: New mechanism introduced for revising rice import duties
latest.text: In November 2025, the President of the Philippines established the new mechanism for revising import duties on rice in accordance with international market conditions, taking effect on 1 January 2026.

latest.title: Philippines: Temporary import duty exemption on tin-mill blackplate
latest.text: In November 2025, the President of the Philippines reduced the import duty on tin-mill blackplate from 3% to zero for three years.

latest.title: Philippines: Mandatory floor price system introduced for purchasing unhusked rice by the government
latest.text: In October 2025, the President of the Philippines established the framework for setting mandatory floor prices for purchasing unhusked rice from domestic farmers by the government.

latest.title: Philippines: Liberalisation of long-term lease of private lands for foreign investors
latest.text: In September 2025, the Philippines liberalised the lease of private lands by foreign investors by extending the maximum lease term from 75 to 99 years.

latest.title: Philippines: Government approves a 55'000 MT import quota on frozen small pelagic fish (September 2025)
latest.text: In September 2025, the Department of Agriculture of the Philippines approved the importation of 55'000 MT of frozen small pelagic fish and fishery/ aquatic products for wet markets from 1 October to 31 December 2025. In November 2025, the import quota was extended until 30 January 2026. In January 2026, the import quota was extended until 6 February 2026.

latest.title: Philippines: Government approves a 22'000 MT import quota on specified frozen fish and fishery/aquatic products (September 2025)
latest.text: In September 2025, the Philippines' Department of Agriculture approved the importation of 22'000 MT of specified frozen fish and fishery/aquatic products. In December 2025, the import quota was extended until 30 January 2026. In January 2026, the import quota was extended until 6 February 2026.

latest.title: Philippines: Temporary ban on rice imports (September - December 2025)
latest.text: In August 2025, the President of the Philippines banned rice imports from 1 September to 30 October 2025. In November 2025, the import ban was extended until 31 December 2025.

latest.title: Philippines: DBP provides PHP 815 million loan to Bright Homes & Realty Corporation
latest.text: In August 2025, the Development Bank of the Philippines announced a PHP 815 million term loan to Bright Homes & Realty Corporation for the construction of residential buildings in Bulacan.

latest.title: Philippines: Government announces certain commitments agreed upon within trade negotiations with the US (July 2025)
latest.text: In July 2025, the Philippines announced certain commitments agreed upon within trade negotiations with the US. It includes the elimination of import tariffs on certain US goods, as well as an increase in imports of US soya products, wheat, and pharmaceuticals.

latest.title: Philippines: LandBank and DBP provide a PHP 100 billion syndicated loan to Power Sector Assets and Liabilities Management Corporation
latest.text: In July 2025, the Land Bank of the Philippines and the Development Bank of the Philippines signed a PHP 100 billion syndicated loan facility agreement with the Power Sector Assets and Liabilities Management Corporation.

latest.title: Philippines: Government further reduces the maximum suggested retail price of imported rice in the National Capital Region (July 2025)
latest.text: In July 2025, the Department of Agriculture of the Philippines further reduced the maximum suggested retail price of imported rice in the National Capital Region (Metro Manila) from PHP 45 (USD 0.79) per kg to PHP 43 (USD 0.76) per kg.

latest.title: Philippines: Import quota of 424'000 MT on refined sugar allocated for selected domestic sectors
latest.text: In July 2025, the Sugar Regulatory Administration of the Philippines (SRA) approved an import quota of 424'000 MT on refined sugars for domestic farmers, sugar millers, refiners and manufacturers, beverage manufacturers, and sugar traders.

latest.title: Philippines: Increase in the export quota of raw sugar to the United States for crop year 2024-2025
latest.text: In June 2025, the Sugar Regulatory Administration of the Philippines increased an export quota of raw sugar to the United States for the crop year 2024-2025 from 66'000 MT to 66'235 MT.

latest.title: Philippines: LandBank announces a PHP 1.3 billion loan to Sagittarian Agricultural Philippines Inc
latest.text: In April 2025, the Land Bank of the Philippines signed a PHP 1.3 billion (USD 22.99 million) loan agreement with Sagittarian Agricultural Philippines Inc to support the construction of the Isabela Feed Mill Complex.

latest.title: Philippines: Government further reduces the maximum suggested retail price of imported rice in the National Capital Region (April 2025)
latest.text: In March 2025, the Department of Agriculture of the Philippines further reduced the maximum suggested retail price of imported rice in the National Capital Region (Metro Manila) from PHP 49 (USD 0.85) per kg to PHP 45 (USD 0.78) per kg. It also eliminated MSRP in all other regions of the Philippines.

latest.title: Philippines: Export quota of 66'000 MT of raw sugar to the United States for crop year 2024-2025
latest.text: In March 2025, the Sugar Regulatory Administration of the Philippines introduced an export quota of 66'000 MT of raw sugar to the United States for the crop year 2024-2025. In June 2025, the quota was increased to 66'235 MT.

latest.title: Philippines: Government introduces the maximum suggested retail price of imported rice nationwide (March 2025)
latest.text: In March 2025, the Department of Agriculture of the Philippines introduced the maximum suggested retail price of imported rice nationwide at PHP 49 (USD 0.85) per kg starting from 10 March 2025.

latest.title: Philippines: Government approves a 25'000 MT import quota on frozen fish and fishery products (March - May 2025)
latest.text: In February 2025, the Department of Agriculture of the Philippines approved a 25'000 MT import quota on frozen fish and fishery products applicable from March to May 2025.

latest.title: Philippines: Government further reduces the maximum suggested retail price of imported rice in the National Capital Region (February 2025)
latest.text: In February 2025, the Department of Agriculture of the Philippines further reduced the maximum suggested retail price of imported rice in the National Capital Region (Metro Manila) from PHP 55 (USD 0.95) per kg to PHP 52 (USD 0.90) per kg.

latest.title: Philippines: Termination of provisional safeguard duty on imports of corrugating medium
latest.text: In February 2025, the Philippines initiated a preliminary safeguard investigation concerning the importation of corrugating medium. In October 2025, a provisional duty was imposed. In April 2026, the investigation was terminated without the imposition of duties.

latest.title: Philippines: Government reduces the maximum suggested retail price of imported rice in the National Capital Region (February 2025)
latest.text: In February 2025, the Department of Agriculture of the Philippines reduced the maximum suggested retail price of imported rice in the National Capital Region (Metro Manila) from PHP 58 (USD 1) per kg to PHP 55 (USD 0.95) per kg.

latest.title: Philippines: Government tightens rules for hiring foreign workers
latest.text: In January 2025, the government of the Philippines introduced the "Economic Needs Test (ENT)" as an additional barrier for foreign workers seeking access to the local labour market.

latest.title: Philippines: Government sets the maximum suggested retail price of imported rice in the National Capital Region (January 2025)
latest.text: In January 2025, the Department of Agriculture of the Philippines set the maximum suggested retail price of imported rice at PHP 58 (USD 1) per kg to stabilise rice prices in the National Capital Region (Metro Manila).

latest.title: Philippines: VAT exemptions for indigenous natural gas and related power generation
latest.text: In January 2025, the President of the Philippines signed into law Republic Act No. 12120, otherwise known as the "Philippine Natural Gas Industry Development Act", which introduced, among other measures, value-added tax exemptions for transactions involving indigenous natural gas. In March 2026, the Department of Finance and the Bureau of Internal Revenue issued regulations implementing these exemptions.

latest.title: Philippines: Definitive safeguard duty on imports of cement
latest.text: In October 2024, the Philippine authorities initiated a safeguard investigation on imports of cement. In March 2025, a provisional duty was imposed. In February 2026, a definitive duty was imposed.

latest.title: Philippines: Increase in preference margin for domestic products and services in government procurement
latest.text: In July 2024, the Philippines announced an increase in the preference margin for domestic products and services in government procurement from 15% to 25%. In February 2025, the measure was enacted.

latest.title: Philippines: Government temporarily reduced rice import duty until 2028
latest.text: In June 2024, the government of the Philippines temporarily reduced rice import duty until 2028. In November 2025, the flat duty was replaced with the new mechanism for revising import duties on rice regularly in accordance with international market conditions, starting from 1 January 2026.

latest.title: Philippines: Government removed the import ban on frozen bonito for canning purposes
latest.text: In May 2024, the Department of Agriculture of the Philippines removed the import ban on frozen bonito for canning purposes.

latest.title: Philippines: Government established import restrictions on certain frozen round scad, bonito and mackerel
latest.text: In April 2024, the Department of Agriculture of the Philippines established the import ban on frozen round scad, bonito, and mackerel for canning purposes.

latest.title: Ireland: Import ban on goods originating in Israeli settlements in the Occupied Palestinian Territory
latest.text: In September 2026, the government of Ireland brought into force a ban on the importation of goods originating in designated postal codes corresponding to Israeli settlements in the Occupied Palestinian Territory.

latest.title: Ireland: Enactment of Act allowing import ban on goods from Israeli settlements in Occupied Palestinian Territory
latest.text: In July 2026, Ireland enacted legislation allowing for the prohibition of the importation of goods originating in Israeli settlements in the Occupied Palestinian Territory.

latest.title: Ireland: EUR 300 million financial grant scheme for electricity price relief for energy-intensive companies
latest.text: In July 2026, the European Commission approved a state aid scheme from Ireland to support temporary electricity price relief for energy-intensive companies.

latest.title: Ireland: EUR 15 million for fishing and aquaculture companies facing increased fuel prices
latest.text: In June 2026, the European Commission approved a state aid scheme from Ireland to support fishing and aquaculture companies facing increased fuel prices.

latest.title: Ireland: EUR 85 million production subsidy scheme for agricultural companies facing increased fuel prices
latest.text: In June 2026, the European Commission approved a state aid scheme from Ireland to support agricultural companies facing increased fuel prices.

latest.title: Ireland: EUR 300 million production subsidy scheme for the production of renewable heat
latest.text: In May 2026, the European Commission approved a state aid scheme from Ireland to support the production of renewable heat.

latest.title: Ireland: Subsidies to the transport and agricultural sector
latest.text: In April 2026, the Irish government announced a EUR 100 million fuel subsidy support scheme to assist the agricultural sector and a EUR 120 million road transporters support scheme to support the transport sector.

latest.title: Ireland: Higher tax rebate on diesel for haulage and bus passenger operators
latest.text: In March 2026, the Irish government increased the tax rebate on diesel for haulage and bus passenger operators.

latest.title: Ireland: EIB and Power Capital Renewable Energy Ltd signed EUR 100 million loan for construction of solar photovoltaic plants
latest.text: In March 2026, the European Investment Bank (EIB) and Power Capital Renewable Energy Ltd signed a EUR 100 million senior debt facility to support the construction of four solar photovoltaic plants (PV) totalling 395 MWp in Ireland.

latest.title: Ireland: EUR 18.9 million financial grant for McMahon Design and Management Limited under Connecting Europe Facility
latest.text: In November 2025, the European Commission granted EUR 18.9 million to McMahon Design and Management Limited for its participation in the third phase of the "PISCES" subsea cable system project.

latest.title: Ireland: EIB and daa signed a EUR 288 million long-term loan for upgrades at Dublin Airport
latest.text: In October 2025, the European Investment Bank (EIB) and daa signed a EUR 288 million (USD 334 million) long-term loan.

latest.title: Ireland: EUR 211 million tax credit scheme for the production of unscripted audiovisual programmes
latest.text: In June 2025, the European Commission approved a state aid scheme from Ireland to support the production of unscripted audiovisual programmes with Irish and European cultural content.

latest.title: Ireland: Mandatory foreign investment screening regime for third-country investors
latest.text: In October 2023, Ireland enacted the Screening of Third Country Transactions Act 2023, establishing a mandatory foreign investment screening regime for non-EU, non-EEA and non-Swiss investors in sensitive sectors.

latest.title: Denmark: EIB and Danske Bank signed a EUR 250 million guarantee for wind energy development
latest.text: In September 2026, the European Investment Bank (EIB) and Danske Bank signed a EUR 250 million guarantee.

latest.title: Denmark: EIFO lends EUR 100 million for Danish-supplied Ukrainian wind farm
latest.text: In August 2026, Denmark's Export and Investment Fund granted a loan to a Ukrainian agro-industrial company to build a wind farm in central Ukraine, supporting a Danish manufacturer's supply of wind turbines.

latest.title: Denmark: EUR 84 million grant scheme to expand clean technology manufacturing capacity
latest.text: In August 2026, the European Commission approved a Danish state aid scheme providing direct grants to companies investing in additional manufacturing capacity for net-zero technologies, their components and critical raw materials.

latest.title: Denmark: NIB provides DKK 182 million loan to Sindal Biogas
latest.text: In August 2026, the Nordic Investment Bank (NIB) provided a loan to a Danish biogas producer to co-finance the expansion of a biomethane plant.

latest.title: Denmark: EIFO provides DKK 1.9 billion guarantee for Cadeler offshore wind installation vessel
latest.text: In July 2026, Denmark's Export and Investment Fund (EIFO) announced a DKK 1.9 billion guarantee to help finance a new offshore wind turbine installation vessel.

latest.title: Denmark: EIB and Ringkjobing Landbobank AS signed a EUR 80 million loan for projects carried out by SMEs and mid-caps
latest.text: In July 2026, the European Investment Bank (EIB) and Ringkjobing Landbobank AS signed a EUR 80 million loan.

latest.title: Denmark: EIFO export guarantee for high-voltage cable supply to German grid project
latest.text: In July 2026, Denmark's Export and Investment Fund (EIFO) issued a guarantee backing a bank loan to a German utility, supporting a Danish company's supply of high-voltage cables for an electricity transmission project.

latest.title: Denmark: NIB signs EUR 500 million loan with Novo Nordisk A/S
latest.text: In June 2026, the Nordic Investment Bank (NIB) signed a loan agreement to finance pharmaceutical research and development expenditures.

latest.title: Denmark: EIFO launches guarantee scheme for SMEs in the defence supply chain
latest.text: In March 2026, the Export- and Investment Fund of Denmark (EIFO) launched a new guarantee scheme to support SMEs in the defence supply chain.

latest.title: Denmark: EUR 5 billion state aid scheme for offshore wind energy
latest.text: In March 2026, the European Commission approved a state aid scheme from Denmark to support the development of offshore wind energy. The scheme is expected to facilitate the construction of two wind farms.

latest.title: Denmark: Biocirc Vesthimmerland Reclaim ApS gets EUR 17.7 million grant from the EU's Innovation Fund
latest.text: In March 2026, the European Commission provided a financial grant to Biocirc Vesthimmerland Reclaim ApS for the “RECLAIM: Renewable Energy Cluster for Agro-Industrial Methanol Production” project.

latest.title: Denmark: Biocirc Vesthimmerland Biogas ApS receives EUR 20.2 million grant from the EU's Innovation Fund
latest.text: In March 2026, the European Commission provided a financial grant to Biocirc Vesthimmerland Biogas ApS for the “RECLAIM” project.

latest.title: Denmark: Siemens Gamesa Renewable Energy AS gets EUR 58.9 million grant from the EU's Innovation Fund
latest.text: In March 2026, the European Commission provided a financial grant to Siemens Gamesa Renewable Energy AS for the "MEADOW" project.

latest.title: Denmark: Arcadia eFuels Vordingborg ApS receives EUR 54 million grant from the EU's Innovation Fund
latest.text: In March 2026, the European Commission provided a financial grant to Arcadia eFuels Vordingborg ApS for the “ENDOR” project.

latest.title: Denmark: Topsoe Battery Materials AS gets EUR 46.3 million grant from the EU's Innovation Fund
latest.text: In March 2026, the European Commission provided a financial grant to Topsoe Battery Materials AS for the “NEXTGEN CAM” project.

latest.title: Denmark: EUR 1.04 billion state aid scheme for supporting extensification of farming and reducing agricultural emissions
latest.text: In February 2026, the European Commission approved a state aid scheme from Denmark for supporting extensification of farming and reducing agricultural emissions.

latest.title: Denmark: EIFO signs EUR 850 million buyer credit facility with ENGIE
latest.text: In February 2026, the Export- and Investment Fund of Denmark (EIFO) signed a EUR 850 million buyer credit facility with the French utility company ENGIE. This facility aims to strengthen international opportunities for Danish exporters.

latest.title: Denmark: NIB signs EUR 21.5 million loan with Solar Park Kvosted ApS
latest.text: In January 2026, the Nordic Investment Bank (NIB) signed a loan agreement to co-finance the construction and operation of a battery energy storage system at an existing solar park in Denmark.

latest.title: Denmark: NIB signs EUR 50 million loan with TDC NET A/S to finance the company’s fibre broadband network rollout investments
latest.text: In January 2026, the Nordic Investment Bank (NIB) signed a loan agreement to finance TDC NET's fibre broadband network rollout investments in Denmark.

latest.title: Denmark: EIFO provides EUR 100 million to support Danish subcontractors in a lithium production project in Germany
latest.text: In December 2025, the Export and Investment Fund of Denmark announced a EUR 100 million loan to Vulcan Energy for its lithium production project in Germany. The financing is intended to support the participation of Danish subcontractors in the project's supply chain.

latest.title: Denmark: EUR 3.8 billion state aid scheme for investment in carbon capture and storage
latest.text: In December 2025, the European Commission approved a state aid scheme from Denmark to support investment in the capture and storage of biogenic, fossil, and atmospheric carbon emissions.

latest.title: Denmark: EIFO co-financed the 55 North quantum technology investment fund
latest.text: In October 2025, the Export and Investment Fund of Denmark (EIFO) co-financed the venture capital fund focused on quantum technologies.

latest.title: Denmark: EUR 626 million state aid scheme for converting agricultural land into forests
latest.text: In August 2025, the European Commission approved a state aid scheme from Denmark to support landowners in converting agricultural land into forests.

latest.title: Denmark: EIFO provides GBP 500 million guarantee for East Anglia Three offshore wind farm
latest.text: In August 2025, Denmark’s Export & Investment Fund (EIFO) announced a GBP 500 million (USD 665 million) project finance guarantee. With this financing, EIFO supports the involvement of Danish exporters Cadeler and NKT in the project.

latest.title: Denmark: DKK 1 billion direct grant scheme for the decarbonisation of industrial processes and domestic ferries
latest.text: In July 2025, the European Commission approved a state aid scheme from Denmark to support the decarbonisation of industrial processes and domestic ferries.

latest.title: Denmark: EIFO and Citi provide EUR 756 million to support Enel Group’s Danish suppliers
latest.text: In July 2025, the Denmark Export and Investment Fund (EIFO) and Citi provided EUR 756 million in financing to support Enel Group’s Danish suppliers.

latest.title: Denmark: NIB signs EUR 27.5 million loan with BioCirc Group
latest.text: In July 2025, the Nordic Investment Bank (NIB) signed a loan agreement to finance the infrastructure and facilities for cleaning and liquefying captured carbon dioxide for transport and permanent geological storage.

latest.title: Denmark: EIFO provides EUR 20 million facility to support Danish exports to Ukraine
latest.text: In June 2025, the Danish export credit agency EIFO announced a EUR 20 million facility to support Danish SMEs and mid-caps exporting essential goods and services to Ukraine.

latest.title: Denmark: Expansion of key components eligible for state aid under green industrial production aid scheme
latest.text: In April 2025, the European Commission approved an expansion of the list of key components eligible for state aid under a scheme that supports the production of certain green industrial goods.

latest.title: Denmark: Vestas Wind Systems A/S gets EUR 20.0 million grant from the EU's Innovation Fund
latest.text: In April 2025, the European Commission provided a financial grant to Vestas Wind Systems A/S for the “CASTRO” project.

latest.title: Denmark: Nakskov Ptx ApS gets EUR 33.2 million grant from the EU's Innovation Fund
latest.text: In March 2025, the European Commission provided a financial grant to Nakskov Ptx ApS for the “Replicative Approach to e-Methanol Production Scaling” project.

latest.title: Denmark: European Energy A/S gets EUR 22.6 million grant from the EU's Innovation Fund
latest.text: In March 2025, the European Commission provided a financial grant to European Energy A/S for the “Replicative Approach to e-Methanol Production Scaling” project.

latest.title: Denmark: INEOS E&P A/S gets a EUR 41 million grant from the EU's Innovation Fund
latest.text: In March 2025, the European Commission provided a financial grant to INEOS E&P A/S for the “Greensand Future” project.

latest.title: Denmark: Aalborg Portland A/S gets EUR 44 million grant from the EU's Innovation Fund
latest.text: In February 2025, the European Commission provided a financial grant to Aalborg Portland for the “ACCSION” project.

latest.text: In February 2025, the European Commission provided a financial grant to Siemens Gamesa Renewable Energy AS for the “PIloting and Validating the manufacturing and assembly of the most powerful Offshore wind Turbine generator” project.

latest.title: Denmark: Siemens Gamesa Renewable Energy AS gets EUR 14.2 million grant from the EU's Innovation Fund

latest.title: Nigeria: USD 200 million funding for long-term financing for enterprises operating in key growth sectors
latest.text: The Nigerian government, through the Bank of Industry, will utilise USD 200 million to expand access to long-term financing for enterprises operating in key growth sectors of the Nigerian economy. The fund is provided by the African Development Bank.

latest.title: Nigeria: Afreximbank Provides USD 64 million in support for Levene Energy Development Limited
latest.text: In January 2026, the African Export-Import Bank provided a USD 64 million acquisition finance facility to Levene Energy Development Limited. The funding supports the acquisition of a 30% equity stake in Axxela Limited to expand gas and power infrastructure.

latest.title: Nigeria: Afreximbank provides USD 750 million facility to Heirs Energies Limited to support the domestic energy capacity
latest.text: In December 2025, African Export-Import Bank (Afreximbank) provided a USD 750 million senior secured reserve-based lending facility to Heirs Energies Limited.

latest.title: Nigeria: NCDMB announces USD 100 million equity investment scheme to support local capacity and participation in the oil and gas industry
latest.text: In December 2025, the Nigerian Content Development and Monitoring Board (NCDMB) announces a USD 100 million equity investment scheme to support local capacity and participation in the oil and gas industry.

latest.title: Nigeria: AfDB approves USD 200 million to support local farmers, youth enterprises and MSMEs
latest.text: In December 2025, the African Development Bank Group (ADB) approved a USD 200 million first tranche of the Multi-Tranche Financing Facility for Phase II of Nigeria's Special Agro-Industrial Processing Zones (SAPZ) Program.

latest.title: Nigeria: Afreximbank provides USD 1.4 billion financing for Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals Complex
latest.text: In August 2025, the African Export-Import Bank (Afreximbank) signed a USD 1.4 billion financing facility for Dangote Industries Limited to refinance the construction of the Dangote Petroleum Refinery and Petrochemicals Complex. This facility is part of a larger USD 4 billion syndicated financing arrangement.

latest.title: Nigeria: Afreximbank provides an extra USD 375 million lending facility to Oando Oil Limited
latest.text: In July 2025, Afreximbank completed the upsizing of a reserve-based lending facility for Oando Oil Limited to USD 375 million.

latest.title: Nigeria: The goverment implements zero tariffs and VAT on imported pharmaceutical
latest.text: On 26 March 2025, the Nigerian government implemented zero import tariffs and VAT on imported pharmaceutical inputs.

latest.title: Nigeria: USD 500 million for Distributed Renewable Energy (DRE) Fund
latest.text: On 12 March 2025, the Nigeria Sovereign Investment Authority (NSIA) announced a partnership for a USD 500 million in funding for DRE Nigeria Fund to develop and finance distributed renewable energy (DRE) projects.

latest.title: Nigeria: NCDMB acquires 20% equity in refinery project
latest.text: In March 2025, the Nigerian Content Development and Monitoring Board (NCDMB) acquired 20 per cent equity in a 100'000 barrels per day refinery project established by African Refinery Group Ltd.

latest.title: Nigeria: Lagos state introduces a 25% discount rate on animal feeds to support farmers
latest.text: On 31 January 2025, Lagos State announced a 25% discount rate on poultry and fish feed to support farmers through the Ounje Eko Farmers Subsidy Program.

latest.title: Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania: NIB signs EUR 60 million loan with Gren Group
latest.text: In May 2026, the Nordic Investment Bank (NIB) signed a EUR 60 million loan with Gren Group to support investments in energy infrastructure across Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania.

latest.title: Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania: EIF and Baltic NFIs invest EUR 225 million in the Baltic Innovation Fund 3
latest.text: In February 2026, the European Investment Fund (EIF) and the national promotional institutions of Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania announced their investment in a capital fund to support the private equity and venture capital markets.

latest.title: Poland, Czechia, and Slovakia: EIB and Kronospan sign EUR 146 million loan for solar power, battery storage, and electric vehicles
latest.text: In December 2025, the European Investment Bank (EIB) and Kronospan signed a EUR 146 million loan "to help the company cut emissions and boost energy independence across its operations in Central and Eastern Europe."

latest.title: Finland and Italy: EIB and KONE signed a EUR 250 million loan for research and development in next-generation elevator and people-flow technologies
latest.text: In March 2026, the European Investment Bank (EIB) and KONE signed a EUR 250 million loan.

latest.title: Germany and Sweden: EIB provides Commerzbank with a EUR 250 million portfolio guarantee to expand electricity grids
latest.text: In April 2026, the European Investment Bank (EIB) and Commerzbank signed a EUR 250 million portfolio guarantee. The support "will enable investments of up to EUR 2 billion in electricity grids in Germany and other EU Member States."

latest.title: Germany and Italy: EIB and Altana signed a EUR 273 million credit line for research and projects
latest.text: In December 2025, the European Investment Bank (EIB) and Altana signed a EUR 273 million credit line to support sustainable research and development projects from 2025 to 2028.

latest.title: Belgium and Netherlands: EIB and ING signed a EUR 400 million loan agreement to support sustainable investments for SMEs and mid-caps
latest.text: In July 2025, the European Investment Bank (EIB) and ING signed a EUR 400 million loan for Belgian and Dutch SMEs and Midcaps

latest.title: Ecuador: Commitments announced under "Framework for Agreement on Reciprocal Trade" with the US
latest.text: In November 2025, the government of Ecuador announced its commitments under the "Framework for an Agreement on Reciprocal, Fair, and Balanced Trade" with the US.

latest.title: Ethiopia: AfDB approves USD 50 million trade finance transaction guarantee for Awash Bank to support SMEs and local corporates
latest.text: In July 2025, the African Development Bank Group (AfDB) approved a USD 50 million Trade Finance Transaction Guarantee facility for Awash Bank SC in Ethiopia.

latest.title: Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania: EIF and Bigbank sign synthetic securitisation to support Baltic SMEs and mid-caps
latest.text: In March 2026, the European Investment Fund (EIF) signed a synthetic securitisation with Bigbank.

latest.title: North Macedonia: Commitments under Framework Agreement on Reciprocal, Fair, and Balanced Trade with the United States
latest.text: In February 2026, the government of North Macedonia announced a framework for an Agreement on Reciprocal, Fair, and Balanced Trade with United States.

latest.title: Sweden, Germany and Finland: EIB and Hemsö Fastigheter signed a EUR 200  million loan for the construction and renovation of energy-efficient social infrastructure
latest.text: In February 2026, the European Investment Bank (EIB) and Hemsö Fastigheter signed a EUR 200 million loan. The financing supports the construction and renovation of energy-efficient public buildings in Sweden, Finland, and Germany.

latest.title: El Salvador: Commitments announced under "Framework for Agreement on Reciprocal Trade" with the US
latest.text: In November 2025, the government of El Salvador announced its commitments under the "Framework for an Agreement on Reciprocal, Fair, and Balanced Trade" with the US.

latest.title: Guatemala: Commitments announced under "Framework for Agreement on Reciprocal Trade" with the US
latest.text: In November 2025, the government of Guatemala announced its commitments under the "Framework for an Agreement on Reciprocal, Fair, and Balanced Trade" with the US.

latest.title: Romania and Bulgaria:  EUR 103.7 financial grant for "CARMEN" smart electricity grid project under Connecting Europe Facility
latest.text: In January 2026, the European Commission granted EUR 103.7 million to Delgaz Grid SA,  Elektroenergien Sistemen Operator, and Transelectrica for their participation in the "CARMEN" smart electricity grid project.

latest.title: Sweden and Finland: NIB signs SEK 700 million loan to Hemsö Fastighets AB for social infrastructure investments
latest.text: In January 2026, the Nordic Investment Bank (NIB) signed a SEK 700 million (EUR 78.81 million) loan agreement with Hemsö Fastighets AB.

latest.title: Spain and Portugal: EIB and Iberdrola signed a EUR 175 million green loan for the construction of the Tâmega wind farms
latest.text: In January 2026, the European Investment Bank (EIB) and Iberdrola signed a EUR 175 million green loan, guaranteed by Cesce, to finance the construction of two wind farms integrated into the Tâmega pumped-storage hydropower complex in northern Portugal.

latest.title: Bulgaria, Croatia, Czechia, Hungary, Romania, Slovakia, and Slovenia: EIF and UniCredit sign a guarantee agreement to support SMEs investing in sustainability, innovation and digitalisation
latest.text: In January 2026, the European Investment Fund (EIF) signed an guarantee agreement with UniCredit.

latest.title: Sweden, Germany and France: EIB and Essity AB signed a EUR 400 million loan for research, development and innovation in the hygiene and health sector
latest.text: In December 2025, the European Investment Bank (EIB) and Essity AB (publ) signed a EUR 400 million loan to support the company’s in-house research, development and innovation activities in the health and hygiene sector in Sweden, Germany and France.

latest.title: Sierra Leone: Afreximbank announces USD 75 million senior debt financing to FG Gold Limited for Baomahun Gold Project
latest.text: In early December 2025, the African Export-Import Bank (Afreximbank) announced USD 75 million in senior debt financing to FG Gold Limited for its Baomahun Gold Project in Sierra Leone.

latest.title: United States of America (Kansas) Broadband Acceleration Grant Program provides USD 23 million for broadband infrastructure investments
latest.text: In October 2025, the Kansas Department of Commerce announced USD 23 million in funding is available to improve broadband infrastructure through the Broadband Acceleration Grant (BAG) program.

latest.title: Spain and Germany: EIB and Iberdrola sign a EUR 500 million green loan for the Windanker offshore wind farm in German Baltic Sea
latest.text: In November 2025, the European Investment Bank (EIB) and Iberdrola signed a EUR 500 million (USD 576.75 million) green loan.

latest.title: Russian Federation: Introduction of an export tax system for mixed vegetable oils, as well as temporary export quotas on sunflower oil and sunflower meal
latest.text: In April 2022, the government of the Russian Federation added mixed vegetable oils to the scope of the existing "floating" export tax system, introduced in April 2021 for sunflower oil. The government also announced temporary export quotas on sunflower oil and sunflower meal.

latest.title: Russian Federation: Introduction of an Export Tax on Sunflower Oil
latest.text: On 6 April 2021, the Russian government introduced an export tax on sunflower oil.

latest.title: Russian Federation: Goods banned from being placed under the customs procedure"free customs zone"in the Kaliningrad region
latest.text: In June 2015, the government of the Russian Federation announced a change in import formalities.

latest.title: Cambodia: Commitments announced under "Agreement on Reciprocal Trade" with the US
latest.text: In October 2025, Cambodia signed the "Agreement on Reciprocal Trade" with the US, committing to multiple measures enhancing trade and economic cooperation with the US.

latest.title: Cambodia: Government announced 0% duty on imports from the US in response to the reciprocal tariffs
latest.text: In April, the Cambodian government announced 0% duty on imports from the US in response to the reciprocal tariffs.

latest.title: Cambodia: Government halts fuel and gas imports from Thailand
latest.text: In June 2025, the Prime Minister of Cambodia announced a halt on all fuel and gas imports from Thailand, effective from 23 June 2025.

latest.title: Germany and Poland: EIB and Molkerei Alois Müller GmbH signed a EUR 100 million loan for RDI and CAPEX programme
latest.text: In September 2025, the European Investment Bank (EIB) and Molkerei Alois Müller GmbH signed a EUR 100 million loan agreement.

latest.title: France, Belgium and Sweden: EIB and Nexans signed two loans worth EUR 250 million for research, development, innovation and industrial investments
latest.text: In September 2025, the European Investment Bank (EIB) and Nexans signed a EUR 250 million loan.

latest.title: Democratic Republic of Congo: Establishment of cobalt export quotas
latest.text: In September 2025, the Democratic Republic of Congo announced that it would lift its ban on cobalt exports and manage global supply by imposing annual export quotas.

latest.title: Democratic Republic of Congo: Cobalt exports suspended for four months
latest.text: In February 2025, the Democratic Republic of Congo announced a temporary four-month suspension on all cobalt exports with the stated objective of stabilizing the market and improving supply chain control.

latest.title: Germany and Bulgaria: EIB and Aurubis AG signed an investment loan for driving recycling and copper production
latest.text: In July 2025, the European Investment Bank (EIB) and Aurubis AG signed an investment loan of EUR 200 million.

latest.title: Malta: EUR 50 million state aid scheme for investments in the farming and processing of bluefin tuna
latest.text: In June 2025, the European Commission approved a state aid scheme from Malta to support investments in the farming and processing of bluefin tuna.

latest.title: Nepal: Local operations requirements for social media platforms
latest.text: In November 2023, Nepal introduced directives for managing social network platforms, requiring them to enlist with the Ministry and establish a local presence or point of contact within three months.

latest.title: Sri Lanka: Import levy on Wheat Flour reduced temporarily
latest.text: A Special Commodity Levy was imposed on wheat flour imports for 1 month, thereby reducing the overall import duty.

latest.title: Czech Republic, Hungary, Slovakia, Poland: EIF and Orbit Capital sign commitment to fuel expansion of innovative SMEs in the region
latest.text: In June 2025, the European Investment Fund (EIF) signed a commitment agreement with Orbit Capital.

latest.title: Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania: EIF and Citadele Bank sign guarantee agreement to boost credit for Baltic companies
latest.text: In June 2025, the European Investment Fund (EIF) signed a guarantee agreement with Citadele Bank to direct new financing to small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) as well as microbusinesses.

latest.title: France, Germany, Italy, Spain: EIF Signs EUR 200 million InvestEU guarantee with BNP Paribas Leasing Solutions to support SMEs and small mid-caps
latest.text: In May 2025, the European Investment Fund and BNP Paribas Leasing Solutions signed a EUR 200 (USD 226.30) million InvestEU guarantee agreement. The stated objective is to enhance access to leasing solutions for SMEs and small mid-caps in France, Germany, Italy, and Spain, focusing on climate change mitigation and sustainability projects.

latest.title: Denmark and Sweden: EIF and Danske Bank sign a EUR 178 million guarantee agreement
latest.text: In May 2025, the European Investment Fund (EIF) signed a guarantee agreement with Danske Bank.

latest.title: Netherlands, Belgium, Spain and Germany: EIF and Triodos Bank sign guarantee agreement to support SMEs
latest.text: In April 2025, the European Investment Fund (EIF) signed new guarantee agreements with Triodos Bank.

latest.title: United State of America (State of Kansas): Kansas prohibits use of AI platforms and genetic sequencing tools from foreign adversaries
latest.text: In April 2025, Kansas enacted legislation prohibiting the use of certain artificial intelligence platforms and genetic sequencing technologies linked to foreign adversaries on state networks and in publicly funded facilities.

latest.title: Mauritius: The African Development Bank (AfDB) approved a USD 160 million loan to AXIAN Telecom
latest.text: On 29 January 2025, the African Development Bank (AfDB) approved a USD 160 million loan to AXIAN Telecom in Mauritius to modernize and expand its 4G and 5G network infrastructure across nine African countries.

latest.title: Turkey: Türk Eximbank introduces preferential loans for women entrepreneurs
latest.text: In January 2025, Türk Eximbank launched a support initiative for women entrepreneurs through the TİM WINGS Project, offering low-interest loans to certified export firms led by women.

latest.title: Colombia: Import duty changes on wheat, barley, yellow corn, soybean, and palm oil products (13 January 2025)
latest.text: In January 2025, the Colombian government temporarily changed the import duties on wheat, barley, yellow corn, soybean, and palm oil products. The measure forms part of the Colombian Price Band System to stabilise import prices of certain agricultural products.
